candidate.answerReason: Parallel lines give similar triangles OAB and OCD. Their corresponding lengths satisfy CD/AB = OC/OA = 2, so CD = 8.

methods.label: Use the similar intersecting triangles
methods.explanation: Since \(AB\parallel CD\), \(\triangle OAB\sim\triangle OCD\) (figure-eight configuration). Thus, \(OA/OC=AB/CD\), or \(3/6=4/CD\), giving \(CD=8\).
